pipeline.title: The order book
pipeline.caption: signed or pitched — not a euro yet
pipeline.legend: A signed work has a date; a pitch has an intention. We don't add them up: the second is not future income.

table.title: Work by work
table.caption: writer share · production points
table.method: Gross master = streams × blended French rate × territory coefficient. Publishing = gross × 15 % (DSP publishing share) × their writer share, minus their publisher's cut. Production = gross × their points. The territory is theirs, for lack of per-performer audience data: hence the “estimated” provenance.
